adjusted_prescription: Although similar demonstrations showing corridor paths around fires on the right, bottom, top edges, and central corridors are available and successful, there is a crucial need for a corrective demonstration explicitly showing the left-edge corridor path starting from the top-left quadrant. This demo should involve moving straight down the first (leftmost) column, then traversing right along the bottom row, and finally ascending the rightmost column to reach the goal, effectively avoiding the central cluster of fires. Including variations of this path with fires placed near the central rows will help reinforce the model's understanding of safe corridor navigation and improve its ability to generalize fire avoidance in situations where central rows have fire hazards. Adding such specific corrective demonstrations will bridge the current generalization gap by explicitly teaching the model to use the left-edge safe corridor, complementing the existing demonstrations on other edges and central paths. This approach ensures more robust fire-avoidance strategies across diverse layouts, enhancing safe navigation performance.
